description: Reinhardt 0.3.5 adapted for HttpArena. Reinhardt handlers and middleware run on Hyper-compatible HTTP/1.1 listeners at :8080/:8081, Reinhardt's HTTP/2 helper serves h2c on :8082, and rustls serves HTTP/2 on :8443. The entry includes database, CRUD, Fortunes, API mix, and Caddy gateway profiles.
